candidates.change_summary: Change the return type's value by returning 17 instead of relying on the interface signature — replaced the declaration so decimals() returns a constant 17 rather than being an interface-only declaration.
Delete the statement that increments mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] by lpUnits, so the LP balance collateral mapping is never updated on mint.
Replace the assignment of the newly added LP amount with an assignment of the minted synth amount into mapSynth_LPBalance.
Replace the computed new LP units with the existing tracked LP balance, so the mapping is set to lpUnits instead of incremented by it.
Relax the guard from requiring a curated pool to requiring any pool, allowing non-curated pools to mint and thus alter their mapSynth_LPBalance.
Delete the statement that increases mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] by the minted amount, so the debt is never recorded.
Replace the debt update key msg.sender with member, so the debt is tracked under the member address instead of the pool address.
Replace the debt increment amount with lpUnits, so the debt grows by LP units rather than the minted synthetic amount.
Replace the debt increment with a decrement, so mintSynth reduces the recorded debt instead of increasing it (reverting when debt is zero).
Remove the onlyPool modifier from mintSynth so that non-pool callers can invoke it and change their mapSynth_LPDebt, which reverts in the original.
Invert the curated-pool check so only non-curated addresses pass, making curated pools revert and arbitrary addresses able to mutate their mapSynth_LPDebt via mintSynth.
